newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas denies deal to sell Cr du Nord.
newsitem.headline: Paribas denies deal to sell Cr du Nord.

text.p: Groupe Paribas denied on Monday a newspaper report that it had signed a deal in principle to sell its Credit du Nord unit to Banques Populaires.
"I am in a position to formally deny that we have signed an agreement in principle with Banques Populaires," a spokeswoman for Paribas said.
Banques Populaires refused to comment on the reports.
On Monday, financial daily L'Agefi reported that a deal in principle had been reached, while La Tribune reported that negotiations broke down over the price.
Sources familiar with the deal said on Monday the talks were suspended at the weekend after failure to reach agreement on the price and other details of the takeover.
L'Agefi reported that Credit du Nord is worth about 1.7 billion francs.
